A_horizon.aftermath_variant: drop minutes within 1440 min after any breach
A_horizon.evaluation_minutes: 2023-01-01 to 2026-05-01 minus 4325 min (common to all bands)
A_horizon.label: a 4% catalog breach in [t+a, t+b]
A_horizon.pre_onset_only: positives with t >= 1% onset of the labeling event excluded (Kamran-style)
A_horizon.within_regime: pairs within the same 24h realized-volatility decile

B_onset.nulls: circular >= 7d and regime-matched (24h-RV decile, +-30d), 1000 draws each
B_onset.onset_rule: first minute after the peak with close <= (1-x) * peak close (catalog rule at x = 1%)
B_onset.per_sample: notebook-18 L1 decomposition with the in-decline split at each threshold

C_power.holdouts: stored summaries only (notebook 11 H1 null draws; notebook 17 H17_all_tests.csv); no holdout data are re-read or re-evaluated
C_power.rule: minimum excess detectable with 80% power at one-sided alpha 0.05 under a shift alternative; exact (null q95 - q20) when draws exist, normal approximation 2.486*sd otherwise (sd from stored q05/q95 or p95)

models: notebook-16 frozen 4% models (M0 coefficient guard, M3 SHA-256 guard), M1 z_vol, M2 VPIN; baseline B0 = trailing 24h realized volatility
